name: Bundle Analyzer

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  analyze-bundle:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 8

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Generate pnpm lockfile
        run: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build with analysis
        run: pnpm run build:analyze

      - name: Upload analyzer reports
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: bundle-analysis-reports
          path: |
            dist/report.html
            dist/report.json
            pnpm-lock.yaml
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Notify Slack
        if: always()
        uses: onekeyhq/actions/slack-notify-webhook@main
        with:
          secret-key: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_SECRET }}
          web-hook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          artifact-type: "bundle-analysis"
          artifact-name: "Bundle Analysis Report"
          artifact-bundle-id: "com.lobehub.lobehub"
          artifact-version-name: "1.0.0"
          artifact-version-code: 1
          artifact-download-url: "https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"
          artifact-build-source: "github-actions"
          artifact-branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          artifact-commit: ${{ github.sha }}
